preconditions.description: The size of the array and the number of queries are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**5 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: All elements in the array are positive integers within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= r <= n for query in queries if query[0] == 1 and len(query) == 4 and (l, r, k) := query[1:])
preconditions.description: For type-1 queries, the subarray bounds are valid.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= k <= 10**5 for query in queries if query[0] == 1 and len(query) == 4 and (l, r, k) := query[1:])
preconditions.description: For type-1 queries, the number of distinct integers k is within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= n for query in queries if query[0] == 2 and len(query) == 3 and (p, x) := query[1:])
preconditions.description: For type-2 queries, the position p is within the array bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 10**5 for query in queries if query[0] == 2 and len(query) == 3 and (p, x) := query[1:])
preconditions.description: For type-2 queries, the value x is within the specified bounds.
There is at least one type-1 query.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line == '-1' or (stdout_line == str(dif) and dif >= 0) for stdout_line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: For each type-1 query, the output is either -1 (impossible) or a non-negative integer dif.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout_line == '-1' and not any(cnt_i > 0 for x_i in selected_x and cnt_i := sum(1 for num in a[l-1:r] if num == x_i))) or (stdout_line == str(dif) and dif == min_possible_dif) for query in queries if query[0] == 1 and len(query) == 4 and (l, r, k) := query[1:] and selected_x := [x_i for x_i in distinct_elements if cnt_i > 0] and cnt_i := sum(1 for num in a[l-1:r] if num == x_i) and distinct_elements := set(a[l-1:r]) and min_possible_dif := min(max(abs(cnt_i - cnt_j) for j in range(len(selected_x))) for selected_x in combinations(distinct_elements, k) if all(cnt_i > 0 for x_i in selected_x)) if len(selected_x) >= k else -1)
postconditions.description: For each type-1 query, the output dif is the minimum value such that there exist k distinct integers with counts cnt_i > 0 and |cnt_i - cnt_j| ≤ dif for all i, j. If no such k integers exist, output -1.
